note: Measured inputs carry status 'verified' with a publisher and period. Scenario inputs carry status 'assumption' and must be presented as assumptions wherever a derived figure is shown.

electricity_price.label: Massachusetts average industrial retail price
electricity_price.caveat: A statewide sector average. A large load would negotiate a tariff or contract; this is not a project quote, and Massachusetts is creating large-load rate schedules that do not exist here.

grid_carbon.label: eGRID NEWE subregion total output CO2e rate
grid_carbon.source: EPA eGRID2023 Summary Tables, Table 1 (subregion output emission rates)
grid_carbon.caveat: An annual average output rate for the whole subregion. It is not a marginal emission rate, and it is not market-based Scope 2 accounting.

pue.label: Power usage effectiveness
pue.source: Atlas scenario input — adjust in the cost panel
pue.caveat: PUE is a scenario input, not a measurement of any facility. The low end reflects a well-run new build and the high end an average operating site.

wue.label: Water usage effectiveness
wue.source: Atlas scenario input — adjust in the cost panel
wue.caveat: WUE is a scenario input with a declared denominator of total facility energy. Closed-loop and air-cooled designs approach zero on-site evaporative water use; the default describes an evaporative design.

utilisation_hours.label: Operating hours at full IT load
utilisation_hours.caveat: 8,760 hours assumes continuous full utilisation, which overstates a real ramp-up year. IT_MW refers to IT load, not total site demand.

construction_usd_per_mw.unit: USD per MW of IT capacity
construction_usd_per_mw.label: Illustrative construction cost
construction_usd_per_mw.source: Atlas scenario input — replace with a project estimate
construction_usd_per_mw.caveat: A placeholder order of magnitude for comparing sites, not a cost estimate for any project. Land, interconnection and site works are excluded.
